notes: Quick Reference now reads the complete temporary authorized session directly from its same-origin Secure Vault iframe after unlock, instead of relying on the summary-only unlock message. The inline Vault should close automatically once the session is detected, the page banner should switch to Secure Vault open, and authorized Shared/Private records can render immediately. No decrypted Vault data is written to persistent localStorage. Adaptive Checklist and encrypted Vault records are unchanged.
